headline: Profitability rebounds sharply from a year ago
summary_short: CrowdStrike reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1.39B, up 18.5% y/y, with net income of $27.8M reversing a $77.7M net loss a year earlier.
summary_long: Revenue rose 18.5% y/y to $1.39B; gross profit rose 21.5% y/y to $1.04B, lifting gross margin to about 75.3% from 73.5%. Operating loss narrowed to $30.6M from $112.98M a year earlier. Net income reversed to $27.8M from a $77.7M net loss, and diluted EPS swung to $0.0275 from -$0.31. Sequentially, EBIT fell 30.9% to $45.2M and EBITDA fell 6.9% to $133.1M versus the prior quarter.
